name: regexp-cold-unique-diagnostic
setup: var uniqueSerial=0;function uniqueRegexpBody(count){var total=0;for(var i=0;i<count;i++){var pattern='([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)(?:unique'+(uniqueSerial++)+')?';var result=new RegExp(pattern).exec('alpha-42');if(result===null)return -1;total+=result[0].length+result[1].length+result[2].length;}return total;}
oracle: 2048*(8+5+2); serial pattern text never repeats within a worker, including warmup and samples
